name: gavi-video
description: Anúncio vertical de 24s do Inglês com a Gavi, programado em React + Remotion.

scripts.editorial: remotion still EditorialCity public/editorial/cidade.png --image-format=png && remotion still EditorialRoom public/editorial/sala.png --image-format=png
scripts.assets: npm run editorial && npm run audio
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render GaviAd out/.video-sem-audio.mp4 --muted && tsx scripts/mux.ts
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run verify
